## Target Market Specializations

### 1. High-Net-Worth South African Residential Buyers
- Geographic Focus: Umhlanga Rocks, Hawaan Forest Estate, Izinga Ridge, Zimbali Estate, Ballito, Simbithi Eco Estate, Durban North.
- Core Assets: Trophy oceanfront residences, contemporary forest villas, secure gated estate homes, off-grid solar and water infrastructure, and zero-transfer-duty new developments.

### 2. Commercial, Logistics & Industrial Decision-Makers
- Geographic Focus: Riverhorse Valley (Northfield Logistics Park), Umhlanga Ridge (Ridgeside & Town Centre), La Lucia Ridge (Glass House Office Park & The Glades), Westway Office Park, Durban South logistics corridor.
- Core Assets: High-cube warehousing (up to 10m height to eaves), superlink truck articulation yards, on-grade and dock-leveller loading bays, heavy 3-phase power infrastructure (kVA), Grade-A sea-facing corporate office suites, and prime mixed-use commercial development land.

### 3. High-Net-Worth Foreign & Offshore Investors
- Jurisdictions: United Kingdom, Europe (Germany, Switzerland, Netherlands), United States, UAE, and South African expats.
- Advisory Framework:
  - Unrestricted Freehold Ownership: Non-residents enjoy complete, equal property ownership rights under South African property law with zero foreign buyer quotas.
  - 100% SARB Capital Repatriation Guarantee: Funds introduced via an Authorized Dealer (Deal Receipt) are 100% eligible for repatriation offshore upon resale, along with net capital growth (post-CGT clearance).
  - Currency Arbitrage: Exceptional value per square meter when purchasing with USD, GBP, or EUR compared to European or North American prime markets.
  - Zero Transfer Duty: Newly constructed development homes (e.g. Sera Bella, Izinga Ridge) feature zero transfer duty (VAT inclusive), preserving upfront capital.
  - Remote Concierge Desk: Virtual 4K property walkthroughs, digital Offer to Purchase (OTP) execution, trusted conveyancing attorney coordination, and private VIP transport from King Shaka International Airport (KSIA).
